reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses a small-business owner in Bareni's calm, practical voice, reframing an abstract topic into a bounded workflow check without sales pressure or prohibited CTAs.
reasons.clarity: The argument is clean, logical, and easy to follow on a first read, explaining the positioning anchor and how to identify drift without confusing jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, concrete manual exercise to test the anchor on one recurring workflow before considering automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: All references to automation and Bareni's knowledge assistant accurately disclose its status as a self-built local demo on synthetic data with locked public access.
